question: After complete camera actions are kept intact, how much related-group crossing remains possible if a later image-model task must also keep temporally adjacent same-camera actions together?
terminal_objective: Pressure-test action identity as a minimum rather than universally sufficient split key, using only the verified action timestamps and an explicit threshold sensitivity analysis.
method: Replay the 2,166 Stage 10J complete actions, cluster consecutive actions from the same camera when the gap from the prior action end to the next action start is no greater than 1, 2, 5, 10, or 30 seconds, and model independent 80/20 assignment at the action level. For a cluster of n actions, mixed-partition probability is 1 - 0.8^n - 0.2^n. Report every threshold; do not designate any threshold as semantic scene truth.
authority: Private local deterministic metadata analysis only. No pixels, model training, publication, outreach, semantic scene claim, actual leakage claim, performance effect, or priority claim.
claim_ceiling: Stage 10N may establish a threshold-sensitive conditional split hazard for temporally adjacent same-camera complete actions in the verified cohort and report non-independent concordance with archive activity and target facets. It cannot call temporal clusters semantic scenes or independent observations, claim observed leakage or a performance effect, designate a universal time threshold, call action grouping universally sufficient, treat time-derived and partly curated facets as independent validation or ground truth, infer facet correctness or image similarity, include unadmitted records as actions, mix cameras into one temporal sequence, infer image content, or claim global novelty or priority.

next_step_logic.if_risk_changes_materially_with_threshol: Treat action identity as the exact minimum grouping key, not a complete evaluation design; freeze the real task and its scene, target, time, or episode dependence before splitting.
next_step_logic.if_a_real_model_task_is_proposed: Choose and justify a task-native broader grouping oracle before training, then test actual partition overlap rather than importing this conditional estimate.
next_step_logic.if_new_action_patterns_are_admitted: Reconstruct actions and recompute every temporal threshold before reuse.
next_step_logic.recheck_trigger: A real AI task, image-content similarity evidence, authoritative acquisition-episode identifiers, revised timestamps, or an expanded action oracle.
